title: Tencent's Large Model Personnel Adjustment: Xu Can, Head of Yuan After Training, Transfers to WeChat WeLM

content_html:
Tencent's internal large model layout has seen another key adjustment. According to "Intelligent Emergence," Xu Can, a senior researcher at Tencent Yuan, has officially been transferred to the WeChat Business Group (WXG), joining the WeLM large model team, focusing on participating in post-training and Agent development. Xu Can is an AI expert with a background from Microsoft Asia Research Institute. He created the WizardLM project as the first author and proposed the Evol-Instruct method. He has deep expertise in synthetic data, reinforcement learning feedback, and automatic evaluation.

This personnel change comes at a time when WeChat AI is accelerating its implementation. In June, the native AI assistant of WeChat, "Xiaowei," has started a small-scale gray-scale test, supporting voice or text control of WeChat functions and directly calling mini programs to complete services.

At the same time, the WeLM team is advancing the research and development of a highly sparse MoE architecture, significantly reducing inference costs while maintaining the total parameter scale, making it suitable for WeChat's massive user scenarios. Xu Can's experience in post-training and complex task execution will help WeLM enhance task planning and tool calling capabilities, strengthening the technical foundation of the WeChat AI ecosystem.

Amid the pressure on the growth of the Yuanbao App, WeChat is leveraging WeLM and "Xiaowei" to carve out an independent path in the competition for C-end AI entry points.

content_html_zh:
腾讯内部大机型布局再次出现关键调整。 据《智能涌现》报道，腾讯缘高级研究员徐灿已正式调入微信事业群（WXG），加入WeLM大模型团队，专注于参与后期训练和Agent开发。 徐灿是微软亚洲研究院出身的人工智能专家。 他作为第一作者创建了WizardLM项目并提出了Evol-Instruct方法。 他在合成数据、强化学习反馈和自动评估方面拥有深厚的专业知识。

此次人事变动正值微信AI加速落地之际。 6月，微信原生AI助手“小微”开始小规模灰度测试，支持语音或文字控制微信功能，直接调用小程序完成服务。

同时，WeLM团队正在推进高度稀疏MoE架构的研发，在保持总参数规模的同时，大幅降低推理成本，使其适合微信海量用户场景。 徐灿在后期训练和复杂任务执行方面的经验将帮助WeLM增强任务规划和工具调用能力，夯实微信AI生态的技术基础。

在元宝App增长压力下，微信借助WeLM和“小微”，在C端AI切入点的竞争中走出一条独立之路。
